experiments.name: Query normalization + dense retrieval (all 4 models)
experiments.dataset: human_validated.json (90 queries, mapped to 232 deduped cases)
experiments.result: No statistically significant improvement; best R@5 = 0.0222 (TF-IDF)

experiments.name: Multi-query retrieval (RRF fusion across variants)
experiments.result: No improvement over single-query dense retrieval

experiments.name: Hybrid BM25+MPNet (RRF and weighted fusion)
experiments.result: No meaningful improvement over dense alone

critical_issues: Human-validated labels are sequential blocks, not genuine relevance judgments
37% of relevant case IDs reference deduped-out cases
110 case IDs reused across different categories

experiments.name: End-to-end RAG evaluation with real 31-document corpus
experiments.dataset: 31 synthetic documents + 19 evaluation queries (8 simple, 3 multi-hop, 3 unanswerable, 2 ambiguous, 2 misleading, 1 conflicting)
experiments.result: Context precision 0.37-0.56 with real retrieval (vs 1.0000 trivial baseline)

critical_issues: Context precision = 1.0000 is trivial (1 context per query, 0.4 threshold)
Circular evaluation: answer = ground_truth, not model output
No documents ingested (data/raw and data/vectorstore empty)
0.16ms latency measured on 60-vector index, not production corpus

experiments.name: Fix SVM ROC-AUC silent zeroing bug
experiments.result: SVM ROC-AUC now correctly computed (0.972-0.997) instead of 0.0000
